title: Guilloché
description: Fine engraved rosettes breathe inside a deep green edition print.
useCase: Membership credentials, limited-edition launches, cultural invitations, or a distinctive mark of provenance.
interaction: Play or pause the material study.
reducedMotion: Displays one stable, representative frame. Responds immediately when the system preference changes.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1; a static CSS composition remains visible when WebGL is unavailable or lost. Fine linework may show moiré at small scales; inspect at the intended display size.
look: Deep emerald textured paper with a double hairline frame, a pale-green engraved rosette ring at right, monospace caps and a cream serif headline at left.
motion: Two angular petal waves in the rosette drift slowly in opposite directions on the shader clock, so the fine engraved lines continuously undulate; a button pauses.
adapt: The rosette is the `FRAGMENT` shader: `petals` sets the 12- and 19-lobe waves and their `u_time` speeds, `phase` the line density, `medallion` the ring bounds, `paper` and `ink` the colours. Replace the print typography; keep the canvas lifecycle and fallback.
